question: Cabinet minister Kinjarapu Ram Mohan Naidu was related to which ministry in May 2025, who was named in the World Economic Forum (WEF) Young Global Leaders list 2025?

options.text: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Civil Aviation**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Kinjarapu Ram Mohan Naidu** was recognized in the **World Economic Forum (WEF) Young Global Leaders list of 2025**, highlighting his leadership qualities and contributions. This recognition is a prestigious honor.
 
• During **May 2025**, he was associated with the **Ministry of Civil Aviation**, which oversees the aviation sector in India, including the development, regulation, and promotion of airport infrastructure and air services.
 
• The **Ministry of Civil Aviation** is crucial for ensuring efficient air transport services, promoting safe and affordable air travel, and enhancing the connectivity across the nation and globally.
 
• Kinjarapu Ram Mohan Naidu's work in the Ministry likely involved contributions toward the modernization of the aviation sector, including innovations in airport infrastructure, policies for regional connectivity, and sustainable aviation practices.
